newsitem.title: USA: Sears completes offer for MaxServ.
newsitem.headline: Sears completes offer for MaxServ.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Monday it completed a $7.75 a share tender offer for all of the shares of MaxServ Inc it does not already own.
About 3.7 million shares were tendered in the offer which together with 7,033,333 shares previously owned by Sears represents about 98 percent of the outstanding shares of MaxServ common stock.
The value of the transaction is about $39.3 million, including all warrants and options, Sears said in a statement.
Sears operates retail stores and provides auto repair and home improvement services.

MaxServ provides information services for Sears customers and for the repair and servicing of appliances and electronics for Sears Home Services technicians. Sears has been a customer of MaxServ since 1983 and accounts for more than 93 percent of MaxServ's revenues.
